svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-flight-jacket-blue","name":"CAP blue flight jacket (worn with the CFDU) with blank nametag","size_in":{"w":55.8,"h":32.975},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,5580,3297.5],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"CAPR 39-1 6.1.7 says the blue flight jacket is \"similar to the MA-1 or CWU-45/P or -36/P flight jackets in design and construction\" (Figure 6.6 shows it: navy, orange lining, gold zipper, knit collar/waist/cuffs, left sleeve pocket). The MIL-J-8279G size Medium dimensions of the MA-1 are carried over: an ASSUMPTION that the blue jacket is cut to the same finished measurements.","dimension_sources":{"back_length_in":"assumed (MA-1 Medium)","half_chest_in":"assumed (MA-1 Medium)","half_bottom_in":"assumed (MA-1 Medium)","sleeve_inseam_in":"assumed (MA-1 Medium)","flap_in":"assumed","sleeve_pocket_in":"assumed","nametag_in":"regulation CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.1","flag_in":"regulation CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.4","loop_square_in":"regulation CAPR 39-1 8.2.5.5","knit_heights_collar_armhole_shoulder_sleeve_girth":"estimated","command_patch_width":"estimated"},"flag":{"side":"wearer's left sleeve (image right)","drawn":"in the garment image (flat sleeve view and, clipped to the arm, the front view)","size_in":[3.5,2],"border":"gold","position":"1/2 in below the shoulder seam, measured from the arched seam at the sleeve centre line (flat sleeve view); front view: the foreshortened face (1.82 of its 3.5 in, as the FDU front view) is tilted with the sleeve centre line and hung so that the canton lies whole on the sleeve, 0.06 in clear of the armhole seam, its nearest corner 1/2 in from the seam top; the outer part wraps round the arm and is clipped by the outline (the loop square on the right sleeve is placed the same way)","orientation":"normal: canton (union) toward the wearer's front / the viewer's left on the outer face of the left sleeve; the reversed flag is for the right sleeve, which this reg does not give a flag","basis":"CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.4 / 8.3.4.4 (left sleeve only); orientation convention per DAFI 36-2903 (flag worn so the union leads forward; Y in artwork-box inches.","top_line_y_in":0.9,"panel_arch_top_y_in":0.9,"cuff_line_y_in":31.975,"panel_cuff_bottom_y_in":31.975,"waistband_bottom_y_in":27.4,"flat_sleeve_length_in":30.63,"flat_sleeve_length_source":"ESTIMATE: jacket cuff bottom up to the corner line under the arch; the sleeve outer edge measures 31.3 in along the edge (OUT); the spec gives the 16 3/8 in inseam only","symmetry":"silhouette, sleeves, cuffs, collar, waistband and flap pockets are one half mirrored about the zip line (audit-flight.js checks it to 0.05 in); only the patches differ side to side"}},"documented":["blue flight jacket is an authorized outer garment with the CFDU (8.3.7) and is similar to the MA-1 / CWU-45/P / CWU-36/P in design and construction (6.1.7, Figure 6.6)","nametag (black leather or blue cloth) on the left breast, CAP Command Patch on the right breast, other CFDU patches optional (6.1.7)","accoutrements follow the CFDU: Command Patch right breast opposite the nametag, US flag 2 x 3 1/2 in on the left sleeve 1/2 in below the seam, authorized patch on a 3 1/2 x 3 1/2 in square of black loop tape on the right sleeve (8.3.4, 8.3.5.5)","grade for officers on top of each shoulder, bottom edge 1/2 in from the seam; general officer stars centred on the shoulder halfway between neck and seam (8.3.3.1, 8.3.3.2)"],"assumed":["finished measurements of the blue jacket are not given: the green MA-1 Medium measurements are used (6.1.7 only says similar design and construction)","navy shade sampled from the Figure 6.6 illustration","knit band heights","collar and knit band heights, armhole depth, shoulder width, sleeve girth","ES patch zone position (jacket has no breast pocket)","command patch width"],"fit":{"method":"n/a","score":null},"grade":"garment"}
